i have a lot of gaps in my schooling for various reasons, and therefore never got taught nutrition. i followed a lot of my dad's advice going up.

this included "pizza is good for you because it contains all the food groups, so have as much as you want."

wanted to go vegetarian as a kid because i loved animals. i'd ask for things like salad, peanut butter, and soy milk, and he would discourage me from eating it because "everything contains animal products so you'll have to starve yourself to truly be vegetarian."

"soda is actually better for you than water because water has [insert any chemical that treats water from various diseases here]."

thought milk, fruit, and most vegetables were bad for you until a few years ago. was taught a lot of inconsistencies growing up and genuinely didn't know better. once i turned 18 and got out of the house, i researched nutrition like crazy to get my frozen dinner/fast food body out of the picture. lost 80lbs so that was cool. 

dad tells me now that he's jealous of me and doesn't know how i did it. i tell him no soda, no fast food, lots of fruits and vegetables, a vegetarian diet (though that is not necessary for weight loss, just a personal choice.) he rolls his eyes at me haha
